# Security Domain - API & Microservices Security Patterns

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Patterns](../../README.md) • [Security](../README.md)**

This directory contains security patterns for API and microservices within the **Security Domain** (cross-cutting). These patterns focus on authentication, authorization, API security, and security architecture for service-based systems.
page_texts.2:
[patterns/security/api-microservices/README.md#overview]

## Overview

API and Microservices Security patterns address:

- **Authentication**: OAuth2, JWT, mTLS, and identity management
- **Authorization**: RBAC, ABAC, and fine-grained access control
- **API Security**: API security best practices, rate limiting, threat protection
- **Security Architecture**: Multi-layer security, zero trust principles
- **Compliance**: HIPAA, regulatory requirements for healthcare APIs

[patterns/security/api-microservices/README.md#patterns-in-this-category]

## Patterns in this Category

| Pattern ID | Name | Purpose |
|------------|------|---------|
| [PTN-SEC-API-001](./PTN-SEC-API-001-abac-authorization-pattern.md) | **ABAC Authorization Pattern** | Attribute-based access control for fine-grained authorization |
| [PTN-SEC-API-002](./PTN-SEC-API-002-jwt-token-pattern.md) | **JWT Token Pattern** | JSON Web Token authentication and validation |
| [PTN-SEC-API-003](./PTN-SEC-API-003-mtls-authentication-pattern.md) | **mTLS Service Authentication Pattern** | Mutual TLS for secure service-to-service authentication |
| [PTN-SEC-API-004](./PTN-SEC-API-004-multi-layer-security-pattern.md) | **Multi-Layer Security Pattern** | Defense-in-depth architecture with multiple security layers |
| [PTN-SEC-API-005](./PTN-SEC-API-005-oauth2-authorization-pattern.md) | **OAuth 2.0 Authorization Pattern** | OAuth2 authorization framework for API access |
| [PTN-SEC-API-006](./PTN-SEC-API-006-rate-limiting-pattern.md) | **Rate Limiting Pattern** | API rate limiting and throttling for security and stability |
| [PTN-SEC-API-007](./PTN-SEC-API-007-rbac-authorization-pattern.md) | **RBAC Authorization Pattern** | Role-based access control for user authorization |
| [PTN-SEC-API-008](./PTN-SEC-API-008-secret-management-pattern.md) | **Secret Management Pattern** | Secure management and rotation of secrets and credentials |
| [PTN-SEC-API-009](./PTN-SEC-API-009-smart-on-fhir-pattern.md) | **SMART on FHIR Pattern** | SMART on FHIR authorization for healthcare applications |
| [PTN-SEC-API-010](./PTN-SEC-API-010-zero-trust-pattern.md) | **Zero Trust Network Pattern** | Zero trust security architecture principles |

*Note: See individual pattern files for complete documentation.*
